label: Trace divine causal reach on actual concreta through the esse-to-ground correspondence
meaning: The carrier-wide causal naming premise and the bridge from a distinct esse cause of an actual concretum to actual grounding yield the ancestor reading. Excluded middle is used for identity. Other readings may warrant mediated reach without warranting the direct causal-and-grounding bundle.

strong_version_needed.cb1cdea9-eb6c-578c-8008-84e0d4107fd3: The premise is applied to a cause whose actual concreteness is not otherwise available: a maximum in esse (maximumEqualsRoot, actualRootMaximum), the uniting or external cause of a supposed composite or distinct-esse root, or an arbitrary given cause or prior. The proof relies on the premise's output that this cause is concrete and exists at w (ActualConcreteGround c x), either to contradict rootness or as part of the conclusion. The weak version ActualEsseCauseIsActualGround (b17a8954) assumes ActualConcrete c and yields only grounds w c x.
strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: EM is applied to x = g, for x an actual concretum. The theorem has no InAct relation and nothing places x in act, while LocalLogic (ca432e24) decides identity with a GOD_4 candidate only for bearers in act in some respect.
